function.name: grep
function.description: Search UTF-8 file contents with a JavaScript regex. Prefer over bash grep/rg. Skips node_modules, .git, dist, coverage, .cursor.

pattern.description: JavaScript regex source (no /slashes/). Do not rely on the g flag.

path.description: File or directory relative to the workspace. Default .

glob.description: Optional filename/path filter (same matcher as the glob tool).

max_matches.description: Stop after this many matches. Default 50, hard cap 200.
